additional_findings: An initial 2B reference produced malformed frontier choices and an untooled early finding; it was not accepted.
The host memory guard refused an overlarge startup budget. A prototype loading flag was unsupported by the pinned runtime; the final worker uses its documented --load-mode none.

The pre-enumeration Q4 run supplied numeric values where source variable names were required, repeated its failed call, and stopped at the duplicate guard. Its old grading path then raised a missing-snapshot error; it established no accepted schedule finding.

The typed-reference run produced the real 17-versus-16 adverse result, a cited branch rejection, an owner question and the real 12 MiB schedule, then repeated a completed call instead of finishing. It failed completion acceptance.
interpretation: These are failed or deliberately interrupted development trials. Their observations do not replace the separately frozen final case family.
